Pay through Direct Pay All payment methods Choose a method that works for you. Not all tax payments are accepted by all payment methods. Bank account All tax payments accepted. Free. Debit or credit card Most tax payments accepted. Fees apply. Digital wallet Most tax payments accepted. Fees apply. Same-day wire All tax payments accepted. Fees may apply. Check or money order All tax payments accepted. Cash All tax payments accepted. If you can't pay now Don't worry. You have options. Try our new tool to get help with your tax debt . Pay over time Payment plans let you pay your taxes over time. If you're an individual, set up a payment plan in your Individual Account . If you're a business, contact the phone number on your notice or call 800-829-4933 . We're here 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. local time. Pay later You can ask us to delay the collection process . Pay less You can request an offer in compromise (OIC) . This lets you settle your tax debt for less than the full amount. Request an OIC in your Individual Account . If you're a business, follow the steps to submit an application . Page Last Reviewed or Updated: 18-Sep-2026 Share Facebook Twitter Linkedin Print
